events.strFilename: NFL 2026-10-04 Washington Commanders vs Indianapolis Colts
events.strDescriptionEN: The Washington Commanders and Indianapolis Colts bring the NFL to London for a Week 4 matchup at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, opening the league’s three-game run in the British capital. Washington will serve as the designated home team as both franchises look to make an early-season statement on the international stage. The Commanders arrive with Jayden Daniels at the centre of an offense built around his dual-threat ability, while Indianapolis will hope its quarterback situation and offensive playmakers can generate consistency against Washington’s defense. With the unique atmosphere of Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and both teams crossing the Atlantic for an uncommon interconference meeting, the first London game of the 2026 season adds an extra layer of intrigue to an already important early-season contest.

events.strDescriptionEN:
The 2026 WRC Rally Italia Sardegna concluded in dramatic fashion, serving as the unexpected season finale of the FIA World Rally Championship following the cancellation of Rally Saudi Arabia.
The event took place from 1–4 October 2026 around the historic city of Alghero, featuring 17 abrasive gravel stages covering over 307 competitive kilometres.

Oliver Solberg and co-driver Elliott Edmondson delivered a masterful performance in their Toyota GR Yaris Rally1 to win the rally. Solberg dominated Saturday to take the lead and pushed hard until the end, keeping his title hopes alive until the very last stage.

The championship came down to a heart-stopping finale when Solberg crashed out of bonus-point contention just two corners from the finish line of the Power Stage, sealing the crown for Evans.

events.strDescriptionEN:
The 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix (officially known as the Formula 1 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia 2026) was a Formula One motor race held on 4 October 2026 at the Sepang International Circuit in Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia. It was the sixteenth round of the 2026 Formula One World Championship and marked the first Formula One race at Sepang since 2017.

The race was originally scheduled to be held at the Bahrain International Circuit on 12 April, but it and the Saudi Arabian Grand Prix were removed from the April schedule following the outbreak of the 2026 Iran war. Following an agreement between Formula One, the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile (FIA), Bahrain and Malaysia, the event was reinstated on the calendar and relocated to Sepang, retaining the Bahrain Grand Prix name. Bahrain retained control over ticket pricing and the right to receive all proceeds from the race.

Max Verstappen (Red Bull) secured his first pole position of the season, also marking the first pole of 2026 for a car not powered by a Mercedes engine. Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) qualified second, ahead of Verstappen's teammate Isack Hadjar. Hadjar's five-place grid penalty for exceeding his allocation of power unit elements relegated him to eighth on the starting grid. This promoted championship leader Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes) to third, alongside Charles Leclerc (Ferrari) on the second row.
events.strResult: Heavy rain initially delayed the start of the race by 40 minutes. The subsequent starting procedure was suspended under red flags after several cars experienced technical problems during two formation laps behind the safety car. The race eventually started 93 minutes later than scheduled. Verstappen converted his pole position into his first victory of the season, and Ford's first victory as an engine supplier since the 2003 Brazilian Grand Prix. Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes) finished second, and Lewis Hamilton (Ferrari) finished third, the latter after experiencing early issues. Antonelli's teammate George Russell retired due to a power unit issue.

events.strDescriptionEN:
The 2026 NRL Grand Final was the national rugby league football championship match contested between the Sydney Roosters and the Newcastle Knights at Accor Stadium in Sydney, on Sunday, 4 October 2026. The match determined the 2026 NRL premiers.

The grand final match was preceded by the 2026 NRL State Championship and the NRL Women's Premiership grand final.
events.strResult: The Sydney Roosters claimed their 16th NRL premiership with a dramatic 19-18 victory over the Newcastle Knights at Accor Stadium. Newcastle made a stunning start, racing to a 12-0 lead through Francis Manuleleua and a spectacular 96-metre try from captain Kalyn Ponga, but the Roosters gradually took control through sustained possession and field position. Mark Nawaqanitawase scored either side of halftime, Billy Smith added another, and Daly Cherry-Evans kicked what proved to be the decisive field goal in the 70th minute. Newcastle refused to surrender, with Greg Marzhew scoring late to reduce the margin to a single point, but the Roosters held firm through the final minutes. James Tedesco produced a monumental performance with 385 running metres and 14 tackle breaks to win the Clive Churchill Medal, while Cherry-Evans ended his NRL career with a second premiership.
